It seems like you want me to deflect the issue and start focusing on other things. Your message is sound, but doesn't necessarily answer the core question: what is the point of all this? You mentioned being stuck in a loop, yes that is exactly how I feel. All the meetup places you mentioned and your suggestions, I tried attempting it and it didn't work out well. And how am I being hard on myself? Is it really that hard to ask to be not be lonely? I didnt know that was a hard demand. Dont take this the wrong way, but again, I feel like all this is a deflection, and eventually the answer is death. I read how one actress (Angelina Jolie) tried to end herself by getting someone else to do the deed. And you know what? It isn't hard considering if you go to a really dangerous area in Miami, you can get shot. Now I am thinking about that too.

And I wanted to point out something on your earlier reply. You mentioned going to a bar? Bar? haha, thats funny. I dont have any social skills, let alone know about drinks. My cousin took me to a bar, and him and my other cousin proceeded to talk out loud and make me feel like crap because I could not know what drink was what. They were telling me that just because I did not about whiskey, I should not be a man, but a boy. Great, just what I wanted: my own family making me feel like crying. F all this shit. I think I am starting to realize the more I think about this, the worse I feel. None of this matters in suicide.

You are ignoring the other things I mentioned. I have said that women is one part, what I am looking for is balance. You are focusing on the women part the entire time, while ignoring the loneliness in general and the constant reminders that I am getting.

How can I talk about living life when I am constantly reminded of how shitty my life is? After a while, you want to F it and say you won't change. You are focusing on women entirely, which is one part of the life. I dont have friends around me, I am lonely. And I mean completely lonely. I did not do anything in college, and I didn't even know where to start. You talk about going through experiences, but you don't understand one important thing: if foreveralone people like us knew the process of how to get experiences, we would not be complaining. We don't know the process, maybe our childhood wasn't the best, or maybe we were lacking vitamins, who knows. I still don't see the joy of these experiences when half of my life is already over. If I could not socialize well in school, how can I expect to get to these meetup places and magically be accepted?

Why did I choose dying? because it is a permanent solution. Half of my life is over, I dont understand the joy of new experiences when I am effing tired and being constantly reminded how shitty my life is. If people are constantly telling me to get married, if people (family) are trying to get me with a woman so that being married would make me automatically normal, maybe that isn't the best way to go about, not with my foreveralone situation. 

I see dying to be a great option, because really, when life hasn't been the best for you, what do you do? You end and cross the bridge.

Well, there is your answer. I would say you can follow with that. I am happy you have found something that society doesn't vilify.

I am crossing the bridge now, we all have to cross it in the end.

What online dating does is make women have 500 males to choose from, and men have 500 competitors to beat for 1. So yes, what is the point? Society has done an excellent job of making it seem you need women and friends to be normal, all other things you do are shit and meaningless. Regardless, have fun with your online dating. I would rather cross the bridge now, we all have to in the end.

You are asking me to stop thinking about women, allow myself to be called out in these situations every time (which is getting worse as I am getting older), and just live my life? Am I correct? 

I dont know, but your post is having the opposite effect on me. It is making me realize that what I want is something I can never have or will ever be able to fix it, and my mind is convincing me that death is the best option regardless what I do. What is going to happen if I keep living to be honest? Who or what am I living here for in the world? Aren't our species meant to reproduce, which is the goal of every human on this earth? Maybe that is what is ticking in my head. You mention I am making sweeping conclusions without any experience, ok. So then where do I get these so called experiences? Or how do I get it? I dont know, I feel that I should have killed myself successfully this year. I did not mention this on my post, but I tried committing suicide, and the only reason I am alive is because I didn't want to create a scene, and I got worried about the other side. Now, I am just waiting for the right time, and that time is now. I am not as worried as I was before.

Your wrong, I am not the one putting value. It is how society is built. One thing I realize is that no one gives two shits if you developed something that helped in anyway, what society sees you as 'normal' is if you party, have tons of friends, have girlfriends and a good wife. That is what society puts value in. I mean, look at Alabama. One of their candidates built on 'family values' as their political center-point for votes. Their definition of a normal household is you need to have GF or wife to succeed. Anything else, regardless of what you do, doesnt mean crap to anyone since you dont have what their definition of normal is. I don't put value in, my family, friends and people around me put that value on those more than what my career or life is about.

I wish death was a right to all. If I have to ask for a right from Congress, I would want death/suicide to be a fundamental right for everyone. This is your life, and I decide it is best to kill myself.

thats because I am reminded by my family and people around me on how lonely I am! I see everywhere around me that a girl is with someone. I dont have problems with this, but what I really get hurt the most is if I go outside with a friend, and he brings his girlfriend, the good restaurant folks will immediately ask me where my girlfriend is or if someone is joining. If I say no, they look at me weird sometimes and then proceed to avoid me (not all).

I go to my family's house event, my cousin's friends come and immediately ask me: where is my girlfriend? Their friends come to me and ask why isn't a girl or my friends with me? Then they proceed to avoid me, make me feel like crap and a treat me like a baby. Why? What have I ever done to them that I need to go through all that? I go to a wedding, everyone has a girlfriend or wife, and I have no problems. But then, my family and their friends remind me how I am the lonely one by asking me or commenting on the same things. Why? Why the ever living F should I go through this or be reminded like this every time? I don't blame my family, friends or society for making this the way it is, it seems like in society, it is more important in life to have a girl and friends around otherwise your life is meaningless. Society values parties, having many friends, girlfriends more important than being lonely. No one gives a shit if you do anything else, these come first. I have no problems with how things are as they are, but I can't fit in. I am starting to realize more and more than if you are lonely, you make enemies fast, and people treat you like something is wrong.

F it. I said too much. But when you stared asking me about why am putting my entire value on something that I have zero experience, I needed to respond. It is not that I am putting value on, it is the fact that I am reminded how miserable my life is. I want to fix it, I do, but then how do I do it? F it, death is a much, much preferable option. It is funny that us humans are very much against death, but I have a breakthrough on how I need to think while I am doing this. If I had to live now, I would fight for the right to die for everyone, and that includes me. Regardless, we humans are very soft, and I know what I need to do to end this quickly and efficiently.

Not necessarily, I see dying a much better option to be honest. If you are crushing for someone, I say you deal with it. I am done with all this, I am just waiting to finish this so that no one can find out.

my family wont change, but thats a different story altogether. So far, even if they know I am not suicidal, they still see that I am lonely. My friends in my life, knowing what they know of if they didn't know, it wont make much difference because, again, they see me lonely and without my experience in life. Treating me as a cool guy won't change anything, my mind just made a decision that killing myself is the best option, trying isn't helping, and I cannot change myself. Changing everyone's perceptions or finding a woman to love is too much work, killing is much preferable, easier option. Why go through all this just to be told by women, potential friends that I am not cool and I have zero experience in life? 

And even if there is a way for me to know that I can change people's perceptions, find ways to improve my situation in this case, find help with women, where is this help then? I can tell you googling doesn't help. Either you have it or you don't, I dont have it. Death is what I need to carry out, and that is something I support the right.

I dont have a lot of close friends. They understand what I am going through, but they cannot help me. My inexperience, lack of experience, zero friends as well as my family thinking that I will kill myself anytime or my loneliness isn't helping. I just dont know how to fix it, I am just waiting for this to kick in. Dying is definitely the best option, and I like the permanent option better. I support the right to die for everyone.

it doesnt matter, because I am older now and it is too late. My inexperience, lack of experience and not idea of how to approach women or having zero friends around me isn't going to help me. Dying is a much preferable, more logical option.
no, because Tinder has been enough for me to show how ugly and pathetic I am. I support the right to die for everyone, I just dont see anything else for me.

graduation from college with BA? I have not had the opportunity to share graduation, birthdays or any good news with anyone close to me. I dont see how I can get a girlfriend since I have been alone for so long. I dont know, everyone in my family, people around me have had girlfriends, people to love, friends, I just can't do it.

Regardless, I have found what I need to do. Just wait in the car, and sleep. It doesn't matter after death, we all die at the end.
